data.description: Enjoy a convenient lifestyle amid technology and innovation at Dubai Internet City.

data.answer:
The community is known for its vibrant business environment, boasting innovation, collaboration, and growth. It facilitates multinational companies, start-ups, and tech professionals worldwide who work and often live in this modern area, promoting creativity and productivity.

Moreover, DIC hosts numerous networking events, workshops, seminars, and conferences throughout the year, providing opportunities for knowledge-sharing, collaboration, and industry networking within the tech sector.

Properties available for rent in Dubai Internet City encompass a variety of options. You can find many apartments and hotel apartments in Dubai Internet City. These apartments vary in size and layout, offering 1 to 3-bedroom units to accommodate diverse needs. Many of these residences are situated within the prominent Dubai Jewel Tower, a towering structure boasting 41 floors. Residents can expect top-notch amenities like high-speed elevators, 24-hour concierge services, and intercom facilities. Additionally, access to gyms, spas, steam rooms, and swimming pools adds to the allure of living in these buildings. Some even cater to the needs of physically challenged individuals.

Penthouses within Dubai Internet City predominantly feature 3- and 4-bedroom configurations, providing expansive living spaces often spanning full or half floors. With floor-to-ceiling glass windows, these penthouses offer stunning sea views, enhancing the luxurious living experience. Additionally, select hotel apartments are available for rent, offering studio and one-bedroom configurations to cater to various preferences.

Popular Properties in Dubai Internet City

Explore the top towers in Dubai Internet City to find your ideal option. Among the most sought-after are Dubai Jewel Tower and Al Salam Grand Hotel Apartments.

Dubai Jewel Tower is the premier choice for convenient accommodation in Dubai Internet City. Developed by Sharaf Group, this towering residential building boasts 41 floors and offers a range of apartment options, from 1 to 4-bedroom layouts, as well as 3 and 4-bedroom penthouses.

Securing the second spot is Al Salam Grand Hotel Apartments. Located on Sheikh Zayed Road, this establishment spans 15 floors and features 225 apartments, including studios and 2-bedroom units.

Completing the list of top contenders is Aurora Tower.

Properties for Rent in Dubai Internet City

Whether you are looking for Dubai Internet City apartments for rent monthly or Dubai Internet City apartments for rent long term, there are many options available. Apartments for rent in Dubai Internet City offer 1 to 3-bedroom configurations. You can also find studio apartments for rent in Dubai Internet City. The 1 and 2-bedroom units boast stunning layouts, pristine rooms, fully equipped kitchens, spacious living areas, and en-suite bathrooms. 3-bedroom flats are notably more expansive, providing larger living spaces. Many apartments also include a maid’s room and storage area.

The average annual rental price for a 1-bedroom apartment is AED 72,000, increasing to AED 99,000 for 2 2-bedroom apartments for rent in Dubai Internet City. For more spacious 3-bedroom apartments, the rent is AED 150,000 per year. Certain apartments boast captivating views of the Arabian Gulf to the west, overlooking Palm Jumeirah. Some even offer vistas of Sheikh Zayed Road and Dubai’s iconic skyline. Annual rents for hotel apartments in Dubai Internet City range from AED 72,000 to AED 84,000.

Offices for rent in Dubai Internet City come in fitted, fully fitted, and shell & core units. Rental prices range from AED 84,000 per year to AED 13.3 million per year. Shops for rent in Dubai Internet City are available at annual costs ranging from AED 1.22 million to AED 1.44 million.

Off-Plan Properties for Sale in Dubai Internet City

Looking for properties for sale in Dubai Internet City? If you are interested in a larger Dubai Internet City apartment for sale, a 4-bedroom penthouse apartment in S Tower, Dubai Internet City, will cost you around AED 17.5 Million. The S Tower, a forthcoming venture in Dubai Internet City, Dubai, presents a selection of residences ranging from 4 to 5 bedrooms.

Iconic Tower is another upcoming residential landmark set within the innovative enclave of Dubai Internet City. This upscale development presents a range of residences, including 1–3-bedroom apartments, two select 3-bedroom units, and a singular, exclusive 3-bedroom duplex penthouse.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Internet City?

data.answer:
Life in Dubai Internet City offers a dynamic blend of professional opportunities and urban convenience. As a thriving business hub, it boasts a vibrant atmosphere filled with innovative ventures and networking possibilities. Residents enjoy proximity to top-notch amenities, including upscale dining options, world-class shopping centers, and recreational facilities. While primarily commercial, the area also provides residential accommodations, offering a unique mix of cosmopolitan living and work-life balance. With its strategic location, bustling environment, and diverse lifestyle offerings, Dubai Internet City caters to both career-driven individuals and those seeking modern urban living.

Public Transportation in Dubai Internet City

Those relying on the metro can easily access the community via the Dubai Internet City Metro Station. The Dubai Internet City Metro Station is one of the most bustling metro stations in the emirate, offering convenient commuting options for DIC employees. For those seeking rental accommodations near the station, Barsha Heights and Al Barsha 1 emerge as prime residential areas.

Moreover, the DIC community boasts numerous bus stops, with buses 83, 84, and 85 shuttling through the area. Dubai Internet City is also connected to the tram route.

Supermarkets in Dubai Internet City

Numerous supermarkets are conveniently situated near Dubai Internet City, primarily located in neighboring communities such as The Greens, Al Sufouh, and Barsha Heights. In The Greens, you'll find Choithrams, while Al Sufouh boasts Aswaaq Supermarket. Barsha Heights offers an array of options including BlueMart Supermarket, F Mart, Park N Shop, and more. For daily essentials, the ZOOM mini-mart in DIC, situated within Dubai Jewel Tower adjacent to the metro station, is an excellent choice.

Shopping Malls Near Dubai Internet City

Dubai Marina, situated near Dubai Internet City is a substantial shopping destination nearby. Boasting numerous retail stores, diverse dining options, beauty salon, and grocery store, it also features a variety of cafes and restaurants. Visitors particularly enjoy its outdoor seating during the cooler months. This mall is conveniently located 10 minutes away from Dubai Internet City, with the similarly accessible Mazaya Shopping Centre.

Adjacent to Al Ittihad Park in Palm Jumeirah and just an 8-minute drive from the area, Golden Mile Galleria Mall hosts approximately 70 outlets, including retail stores, healthcare facilities, supermarkets, and a fitness club. It also offers a range of casual dining restaurants.

Other prominent malls near DIC Dubai, such as Mall Of The Emirates and Ibn Battuta Mall, are also within a 10-minute drive.

Schools Near Dubai Internet City

Blossom Palm Jumeirah, Redwood Montessori Nursery, and Asya’s Nursery are all situated in Palm Jumeirah, approximately a 12-minute drive away. British Orchard Nursery in Dubai Media City is even closer, just a 6-minute car ride away.

Near Dubai Internet City, there are several schools. The International School of Choueifat Al Sufouh is reachable within 11 minutes by car and follows the SABIS (UK/US) curriculum from KG1 to Grade 12. Regent International School, following the National Curriculum of England, is also an 11-minute drive away.

Other nearby schools include GEMS Wellington International School, GEMS Dubai American Academy, and American School of Dubai, accessible within a 13 to 17-minute car ride.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near Dubai Internet City Area

Residents in this vicinity have access to Fellowship: A Christian Church in Dubai and Coza Church, both a short 10 to 11-minute car ride away. The Old Apostolic Church (MENA) is situated in Barsha Heights, while the Seventh Day Adventist Church is located in Al Sufouh 2, both reachable within an 11-minute drive by car.

In Jebel Ali Village, just a 15-minute drive away, residents will find several churches including St Mina Coptic Orthodox Church, Covenant Hope Church, and St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church, among others.

Additionally, the Sikh Gurudwara, Guru Nanak Darbar Gurdwara, is also located in Jebel Ali Village. Hindu residents can visit the Shiva Temple, Shree Krishna Haveli, and ShrinathJi Temple in Bur Dubai, approximately 30 minutes away.

Near Dubai Internet City, there is a selection of mosques available. The nearest is Tecom Masjid, only a 5-minute drive away. Other nearby mosques include Greens Mosque and Hamel Al Gaith Mosque, both reachable in under 10 minutes.

Clinics and Hospitals in Dubai Internet City Dubai

Hospitals in proximity to Dubai Internet City encompass Al Zahra Hospital and Saudi German Hospital, both renowned establishments situated in Al Barsha, approximately 14 minutes away. These hospitals are tertiary care facilities equipped with comprehensive healthcare services.

For clinics nearby DIC, options include Mediclinic Meadows, Mediclinic Al Sufouh, and American Hospital Clinic Media City, reachable within 6 to 12 minutes.

Dubai Internet City Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

The vicinity is close to the Arabian Gulf and the Palm Jumeirah waterfront development. Prominent residential areas nearby include Al Sufouh, The Greens, and Barsha Heights.

Commercial hubs like Dubai Media City and Dubai Knowledge Park are situated to the northwest, while Emirates Hills lies just across Sheikh Zayed Road to the south of Dubai Internet City.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Internet City

data.answer:
In Dubai Internet City, an array of activities awaits, catering to diverse interests. From exploring cutting-edge technology centers to indulging in gourmet dining experiences, there's something for everyone. Dive into the world of innovation at tech exhibitions or unwind with a stroll along picturesque waterfront promenades. For those seeking relaxation, pamper yourself at luxurious spas or soak up the sun at nearby pristine beaches. With its proximity to iconic landmarks and cultural attractions, Dubai Internet City offers a captivating blend of modernity and leisure, ensuring an unforgettable experience for residents and visitors alike.

Restaurants In and Near Dubai Internet City Dubai

DIC Dubai boasts a diverse array of dining options. Fast food aficionados can indulge in Popeyes, Subway, and Burger King. Indian cuisine enthusiasts have options like Paratha King, The Rupee Room, and Kamat. For Arabian cuisine, Al Safeer, Mantoushe, and Diwan Layalina are popular choices.

Additional nearby restaurants include Puranmal Restaurant, an Indian eatery specializing in sweets and other dishes. Taqado Mexican Kitchen, listed among the top 8 Mexican restaurants in Dubai, is an 8-minute drive away. The Noodle House and Qutoof Restaurant are both reachable within 9 minutes.

For nightlife, ICON Bar & Lounge at the Radisson Blu Hotel, Dubai Media City, and The Rooftop Terrace at the One&Only Royal Mirage hotel offer enticing options.

Beaches Near Dubai Internet City 

Given its proximity to the Arabian Gulf, Dubai Internet City enjoys easy access to popular beaches, notably Al Sufouh Beach and JBR Beach. Al Sufouh Beach, nestled between Burj Al Arab and Palm Jumeirah, is often hailed as a hidden gem and one of Dubai’s finest. Sometimes referred to as Black Palace Beach, it lies just 13 minutes away.

JBR Beach, a top tourist destination in Dubai, offers a vibrant atmosphere. It features The Beach, an outdoor mall, numerous waterfront restaurants, and ample lounging areas. Additionally, visitors can enjoy a jogging/walking track and a variety of outdoor exercise equipment along the beach.

Hotels in Dubai Internet City Dubai

Dubai Internet City, located less than 1 km from the coast, enjoys proximity to several upscale hotels, including:

Grand Plaza Mövenpick Media City: Positioned in the heart of DIC, this 5-star hotel caters to both business and leisure travelers. It offers 235 spacious rooms and suites inspired by Middle Eastern culture. Additionally, it features a state-of-the-art convention center with a ballroom capable of accommodating up to 800 guests. With nine meeting rooms equipped with high-tech audiovisuals, free Wi-Fi, and lighting equipment, it's an ideal venue for meetings, weddings, and conventions. Accessible via a short 3-minute car ride.

Al Salam Grand Hotel Apartments: Situated on Sheikh Zayed Road within Dubai Media City, a mere 9-minute drive from Dubai Internet City, this facility boasts 15 floors housing 225 studios, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments with spacious layouts. Many units offer private balconies showcasing spectacular sea views and feature fully equipped kitchens and connecting rooms.

Holiday Inn Express Dubai Internet City: This 244-room hotel offers a complimentary buffet breakfast, a 24-hour fitness center, a business center, and complimentary Wi-Fi. It also provides three meeting rooms accommodating up to 120 guests.

Two Seasons Hotel & Apartments Dubai Internet City: Two Seasons Hotel & Apartments in Dubai Internet City offers a luxurious accommodation experience with a blend of hotel rooms and serviced apartments, providing guests with a comfortable and convenient stay in the heart of the city's vibrant business district.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai Internet City

Here are three landmarks near Dubai Internet City along with their driving distances:

Burj Al Arab: One of Dubai's most iconic landmarks, the Burj Al Arab is a symbol of luxury and architectural grandeur. Situated approximately 15 minutes away from Dubai Internet City, this sail-shaped hotel is a must-see for visitors to the area.

Mall of the Emirates: A premier shopping destination in Dubai, Mall of the Emirates offers an unparalleled retail experience, featuring high-end brands, entertainment options like Ski Dubai, and a wide array of dining choices. It is conveniently located just a 10-minute drive from Dubai Internet City.

Palm Jumeirah: A man-made island renowned for its luxury resorts, stunning beaches, and upscale residences, Palm Jumeirah is a must-visit destination. It's approximately 12 minutes away from Dubai Internet City and offers various attractions including Atlantis, The Palm, and the Palm Jumeirah Boardwalk for strolls with breathtaking views of the Dubai skyline.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

In the vicinity, fitness enthusiasts have several gym options close by. Fitness First, Snap Fitness, and Body Time Tecom are all within a 10-minute drive.

For women looking for beauty services, nearby beauty salons are just an 8-minute drive away. These include The Work Salon + Spa, Tulip Ladies Salon, and The Cure. Men can also find grooming services nearby, with Handsome Men Salon and Cutting Line Gent’s Salon both reachable within 9 minutes by car.
Dubai Internet City offers residential and hotel apartments with numerous advantages. However, being primarily a commercial hub, it experiences significant traffic congestion during peak hours.

Is Dubai Internet City a free zone?

Yes, Dubai Internet City is a free zone. It was established as a free economic zone by the government of Dubai to facilitate the growth of the information and communication technology industry.

Is Dubai Internet City a good place to live?

Whether Dubai Internet City is a good place to live depends on individual preferences and priorities. As a primarily commercial area, it may not offer the same residential amenities and lifestyle options as other neighborhoods in Dubai. However, its proximity to major business hubs, recreational facilities, and shopping centers can make it convenient for those working in the area.

Is Dubai Internet City in DIFC?

No, Dubai Internet City is not located within the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC). While both are prominent business districts in Dubai, they are separate entities with distinct purposes and locations within the city.

Are there any notable landmarks near Dubai Internet City?

Dubai Internet City is located near several notable landmarks, including the Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Golf Club, and the iconic Burj Al Arab.

What types of companies are based in Dubai Internet City?

The area is a hub for tech and media companies, with global IT giants like Microsoft and Oracle among its many residents.

Is public transportation available to Dubai Internet City?

Public transportation is easily accessible, with the Dubai Metro, buses, and taxis serving the area.

Are there accommodations near Dubai Internet City?

Numerous hotels and serviced apartments are available nearby for accommodations.

What amenities are available within Dubai Internet City?

Within Dubai Internet City, there are a variety of amenities such as dining options, gyms, retail shops, and business centers, providing convenience for those working or visiting the area.

data.content:
Dubai Internet City (DIC) is the Middle East's leading technology business community, which the government of Dubai developed. It fosters innovation, collaboration, and growth in the region's thriving tech sector.

Launched in 2000, DIC is a free zone to facilitate and promote Information Technology (IT) systems and services throughout the UAE. Along with modern office spaces, cutting-edge facilities, and access to a diverse talent pool, the area is home to residential units located in high-rise towers.

The district is well-connected to the Dubai Metro Red Line, offering residents an easy commute. Various modern apartments are available for sale and rent in Dubai Internet City, offering breathtaking views of the skyscrapers and many tourist attractions in the city.
